240-1849-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-1849-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

3899-7084-8232.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters and Alharu trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Alharu trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

512-1432-3990.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land that can tap to produce {W}.
Incubation Druid and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
512-1432-3990.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Incubation Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1432-3990.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Incubation Druid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

2382-4247-5659--33.notablePrerequisites: One Lhurgoyf must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mimic Vat.
2382-4247-5659--33.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a nontoken Lhurgoyf.
When the Lhurgoyf dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard and returning the Lhurgoyf that was exiled to your graveyard.
Disa's first ability triggers, putting the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

2169-3899--5.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}, causing your creatures to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 2

1981-2415-6798-7818.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6798-7818.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2438-3413-5929.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Leyline of Transformation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1020-1117-6518-7646.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

252-1575-5776-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2079-4091-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

876-4871-7072.description:
If needed, activate LIghtning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Joo Dee.
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3705-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

864-972-3542.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
864-972-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is an artifact.
When the Palinchron token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying its mana cost.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness and the Palinchron token.
When the Eternal Witness and Palinchron tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
864-972-3542.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Palinchron and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Eternal Witness instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

270-1987-2468-3094.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hedron Archive by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Hedron Archive and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

851-2457-3000-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Squirrel and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1357-4285-4697.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two mana producing permanents, one of which can tap to produce at least {U}.
1357-4285-4697.description:
Cast Reality Spasm by paying at least {3}{U}{U}, targeting at least three permanents and choosing the untap mode.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Reality Spasm, targeting at least three permanents.
Holding priority, activate at least two mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, copying the Reality Spasm copy, targeting Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Resolve the copy of Reality Spasm from step 3, untapping Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.
1357-4285-4697.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} extra when casting Reality Spasm initially. If you choose not to, you will not get infinite untap of permanents or mana from those permanents, unless one of the mana-producing permanents taps to produce two or more mana.

1563-4094-4321-5777.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
You control a Food.
1563-4094-4321-5777.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2713-4499-5424.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Sailor of Means.
When Sailor of Means enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1636-2850-3143.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one green creature token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
1636-2850-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of a green creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Ivy Lane Denizen trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Ivy Lane Denizen trigger, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.

1339-1939-4279.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-1939-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1482-5445-5660.notablePrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Evolution Witness.
1482-5445-5660.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color that can only be spent to cast your commander.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

457-1379-1912-2043.description:
Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Biomancer's Familiar that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability by tapping the Biomancer's Familiar token, adding {U}.
Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {2}, creating a token copy of Biomancer's Familiar that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability by tapping the Biomancer's Familiar token, adding {U}.
Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {1}, creating a token copy of Biomancer's Familiar that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability by tapping the Biomancer's Familiar token, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 5.

876-4421-4875-4881-4951.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least fifty.
"Angel" or "Cleric" chosen with Conspiracy.
876-4421-4875-4881-4951.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Priest of Fell Rites.
Activate Priest of Fell Rites by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Priest of Fell Rites.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, Righteous Valkyrie's first ability triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Activated Sleeper's toughness.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Activated Sleeper.
Activate Activated Sleeper by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Priest of Fell Rites from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Fell Rites enters the battlefield, Righteous Valkyrie's first ability triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Priest of Fell Rites' toughness.
Repeat.

486-4003-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel does not have summoning sickness.
Mu Yanling has at least ten loyalty counters on it.
486-4003-4312.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Mu Yanling to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Vorel by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of loyalty counters on Mu Yanling.
Activate Mu Yanling's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

687-2012-2034-3644.notablePrerequisites: Stangleroot Geist and Young Wolf do not have +1/+1 counters on them.
687-2012-2034-3644.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist and Young Wolf, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Strangleroot Geist and Young Wolf's undying abilities trigger, returning both from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a vigilance counter.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing both counters from Young Wolf, and removing a +1/+1 counter from Strangleroot Geist, causing you to mill three cards and allowing you to return a permanent with mana value three or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

892-1061-1953.manaNeeded: {6}{U}{U}{U}{U} on your first turn, with {2}{U}{U} available on each extra turn
892-1061-1953.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
892-1061-1953.description:
Cast Sublime Epiphany by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Timestream Navigator token.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it and putting it onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat from step 2.
